semantic_corpus.title: feat(review): add deep-review specialist advisory passes (#608)
semantic_corpus.description: PR #623 / issue #608 sequencing miss. The dogfood found that a reviewer launching the three specialist roles but not waiting for them before the final review call was credited for the 'specialists must terminate/reap before final review begins' invariant, even though the specialists were still running. The grader credits any signal that asserts the reap-before-final sequencing, regardless of phrasing, and the harness reports which stage caught it (the issue can be caught by the specialist phase log, the primary final reviewer, or the post-hoc escalation lane).

known_findings.description: Specialist phase is launched but not reaped before the final review call enters, so a hung specialist stalls the deep-review contract.

semantic_corpus.title: feat(review): add deep-review specialist advisory passes (#608) — failure contract
semantic_corpus.description: PR #623 / issue #608 failure-contract miss. The PR promised the per-role specialists-*.json artifact and the deterministic specialists.json aggregate on every run, including catastrophic specialist failure. A reviewer that only inspected the happy-path artifact would miss that the failure contract was violated. The grader credits any signal that names the artifact state on failure, in any phrasing, and the harness reports which stage caught it.

known_findings.description: On catastrophic specialist failure, the per-role specialist-*.json artifact and the deterministic specialists.json aggregate are not written, so downstream consumers see a missing-file error instead of the fail-soft degraded entry.

semantic_corpus.description: Clean negative control for #627. A trivial dependency bump with no specialist or output-completeness regression. The fixture exists to guard against 'recall improvements come from more findings': any signal classified as control_flow_sequencing or output_completeness is fabricated and fails the scenario. A genuine approve/clean review passes.

metadata.description: Historical dogfood regression corpus (#627). Each fixture reconstructs a real dogfood miss so prompt / harness / model / specialist / escalation changes can be evaluated against known failure classes. Semantic scoring accepts materially equivalent findings (capability-class match, not exact phrasing). PR #623 / issue #608 contributes both the control-flow-sequencing case and the failure-contract case. The negative-control fixture (PR #8004) prevents recall improvements from more findings — any fabricated sequencing or output-completeness finding fails it. Run via `python -m pytest tests/test_semantic_eval.py` for the deterministic CI path; live-model benchmarks stay on the existing eval-harness workflow conventions. A configured primary + escalation routing pair is exercisable through the `route` field without baking specific model names into production behavior.
